verses.1: And you, son of man, take a pebble for yourself, and set it before you. Then write on it the laws of Jerusalem.
verses.2: And You gave her a tent, and You built a house for her. You also poured salt on her. And You placed shops around her.
verses.3: And you shall take a metal sheet, and place it as a wall between you and the city. Then you shall prepare your face for it, so that it becomes a wall. And you shall use it as a boundary between you and the city.
verses.4: And you, the Samaritan, lie down on your side. You bear the burden of Israel’s sins. For days will pass before you can be freed from this burden.
verses.5: And I have given you two years to count the days: three hundred and ninety days. During those days, you shall carry the burden of Israel.
verses.6: And you shall carry these on your side, once again. You shall bear the burden of the house of Judah for forty days. One day each year. You shall give them to me.
verses.7: And before the Temple in Jerusalem, you shall prepare your faces and your descendants. You shall be lifted up onto it.
verses.8: And behold, I have given you heavy burdens to bear, and you must not change from one side to the other until your days are over.
verses.9: And you shall take some wheat, barley, lentils, peas, and other grains. You shall put them all together in one container. Then you shall make from these grains bread for yourself. You shall eat it after the number of days that you have spent on your side has reached three hundred and ninety days.
verses.10: And whatever you eat from it, it will be fifty shekels per day, from that moment until the end.
verses.11: And from the waters that flow, they will drink the water of life, from time to time.
verses.12: And the horn will be eaten by us. It will be a disgrace to the birth of man; it will be a shame for them to see it.
verses.13: And the LORD said, “In this way, the children of Israel shall eat the unclean meat in the countries that I have given them.”
verses.14: And he said, “Ah, Adonai Yahweh! Look, my soul is not burdened or troubled. I have not eaten anything since my youth, and still today, my mouth remains empty.”
verses.15: And he said to me, “Look, I have given you the stars as a sign in the sky. And you have placed your blood upon them.”
verses.16: And he said to Adam, “I have finished making bread in Jerusalem. But we still eat bread, with worry and anxiety. And we also drink water, but it’s not enough.”
verses.17: So that there will be no bread or water, and one person and his brother will die in their misery.
